title.en: An Act to Create the Municipality of Talalora in the Province of Samar
title.orig: An Act to Create the Municipality of Talalora in the Province of Samar

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1947/ra_192_1947.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The barrios of Mallorga, Tulac, Talalora, Tatabonan, Navatas, and Navatas Guti are separated from the municipality of Villareal, Province of Samar, and constituted into a new and regular municipality to be known as the municipality of Talalora in the Province of Samar.
The officials of the newly created municipality shall be appointed by the President, to hold office until their successors have been elected and qualified.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1947.
